info.title: bible-wikipedia-summary
info.description: The opening of an English Wikipedia article (the REST page-summary endpoint). Text is CC BY-SA 4.0; always show the page URL with it. Titled apart from any other realm's Wikipedia API: a world holds one API per name.

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: The article title with spaces as underscores, e.g. `Francis_of_Assisi`.
